 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Earth is made up of three layers: Crust, Mantle and Core.
 
• The Crust
 
 
• ​​The crust is the uppermost layer over the earth's surface.
 
• It is the thinnest layer.
 
• It is only about 5 km on the ocean floors, which mainly consists of silica and magnesium thus called sial, and 35 km on the continental masses, which mainly consist of silica and alumina​
 
 
 
• ​The Mantle
 
 
• ​The mantle extends up to a depth of 2900 km below the crust.
 
• It is bounded below by a core and above by a crust.
 
• The upper part of the mantle is known as the asthenosphere.
 
 
 
• ​The Core
 
 
• ​The innermost layer is the core with a radius of about 3500 km and is divided into the Inner and Outer core.
 
• It is called nife as it is mainly made up of nickel and iron.
 
• The central core is called as the Inner Core and has a very high temperature and pressure.
